protocol.scope: Same-video CPU selection and baseline assessment pilot, not full causal/method validation
protocol.primary_gate: At least two independent sources with a BRISQUE/MUSIQ agreed restoration increasing speaker error by >=1/24, plus any restoration reducing error in at least one source.
protocol.primary_cases: Original 8 cases, original 4 candidates; gate unchanged
protocol.expanded_cases: All 8 original and 3 additional cases; common captured/spatial_nlm/fastdvdnet candidates
protocol.exclusions: Unverified AV-SpeakerBench labels excluded from accuracy; DMD gaze not an ASD test
protocol.quality: BRISQUE/MUSIQ means over frames 0,12,24; SSIM diagnostic only
protocol.detection: Fixed, untrained risk scores on noninput candidates: disagreement, uncertainty, input MSE, negative MUSIQ, BRISQUE
protocol.harm_label: At least one correct-to-incorrect frame; report net-worse cases separately
protocol.coverage: Full coverage for every selection rule; no abstention
protocol.sensitivity: Repeat summaries on tracks whose source-reference predictions are all correct
protocol.limits: Reused sources; 3 additional tracks all silent; no held-out trained assessor or enhancer transfer

detection.interpretation: Descriptive ranking of fixed baselines on reused cases; not validated novel assessor performance
